errors.serviceNotRunning: RealTimeX Link's service is not running
errors.otherVersion: RealTimeX Link's service is from another version; reinstall RealTimeX Link
errors.notAnswering: RealTimeX Link's service is not answering ({error})
errors.cannotProve: RealTimeX Link's service could not prove itself; restart RealTimeX Link
errors.daemonMissing: rtx-linkd is not installed next to RealTimeX Link
footer.installedHint: Change what is shared, and control your other computers, in RealTimeX.
footer.notInstalledHint: To see and control your other computers from this one, get RealTimeX.
account.title: Account
account.viaRealtimex: Signed in through RealTimeX on this computer.
account.pitch: Sign in to your RealTimeX account, so other computers can reach this one through RealTimeX's relay and your own computers can connect without asking.
account.finishInBrowser: Finish signing in in your browser…
request.someoneElse: This computer belongs to someone else. Only allow it if you expect it.
request.remembered: {expires} · Once allowed, it connects without asking next time.
request.allowedControl: {name} can now control this computer. It connects without asking next time.
request.allowedView: {name} can now view this computer. It connects without asking next time.
host.title: Remote control
host.description.unsupported: Remote control isn't available on this desktop.
host.description.relayOnly: Other computers can connect through RealTimeX's relay (Tailscale isn't running).
host.description.waitingTailscale: No other computer can connect until Tailscale runs.
host.description.needsPermissions: Allow the macOS permissions below, then other computers can connect.
host.description.tailscaleOrRelay: Other computers can connect over Tailscale or through RealTimeX's relay.
host.description.tailscale: Other computers on your Tailscale network can connect.
host.turnedOff: Remote control is off. No other computer can connect.
host.offExplained: Remote control is off. No other computer can see or use this screen. Turn it on to give another computer this App ID and password.
permissions.title: Allow RealTimeX Link to see and control this Mac
permissions.explain: macOS asks for this once. Open each setting, turn on RealTimeX Link, then check again.
tailscale.notRunning: Other computers reach this one over your Tailscale network. Start Tailscale and sign in.
password.signsOutAll: Every computer is signed out and must use the new password.
password.changed: Password changed. Every computer must sign in again.
password.regenerated: New password. Every computer must sign in again.
policy.title: When a new computer asks to connect
policy.askHelp: You allow or deny each one here; it expires after a minute
policy.ownAccount: Allow my own computers without asking
policy.ownAccountHelp: New computers on your account are let in at once; others ask
policy.passwordOnlyHelp: New computers need the App ID and password; no requests
access.title: Access for new computers
access.fullHelp: See the screen, use the mouse and keyboard, the clipboard and files
access.defaultsSaved: New computers get this access. Computers already here keep theirs.
clients.description: Computers that signed in with this App ID and password. Each one has its own permission.
clients.none: No computers yet. Give another computer this App ID and password to connect.
clients.nowView: {name} can now only view this computer.
clients.disconnected: {name} was disconnected. It can connect again; block it to stop that.
clients.blockedDone: {name} can't connect until you allow it again.
confirm.turnOff.title: Turn off remote control?
confirm.turnOff.message: No other computer can see or use this screen until you turn it on again. Any session ends now.
confirm.newPassword.title: Make a new password?
confirm.newPassword.message: Every computer is signed out and must use the new password.
confirm.stop.title: Stop {name}'s session?
confirm.stop.message: It stops seeing and controlling this computer now. It can connect again unless you block it.
confirm.remove.title: Remove computer
confirm.remove.message: Remove {name}? Its session ends. With the password it can connect again as a new computer.
confirm.signOut.title: Sign out?
confirm.signOut.message: Your own computers ask before connecting again, and the relay can't be set up again until you sign in. Computers already here keep their access.
settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHelp: Choose the visual theme for the application.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used throughout the application.
settings.realtimexNote: RealTimeX sets these to match its own settings when it starts and whenever you change them there.
settings.cantShow: Link can't show {language} on this computer yet, so it uses English.
settings.saveFailed: Link kept the previous one. Check that RealTimeX Link is running, then try again.
link.onDescription: Starts at login and keeps this computer reachable, even when RealTimeX is closed.
link.offDescription: Published artifacts, webhooks, the mobile app and remote control can't reach this computer. It won't start at login.
link.turnedOn: RealTimeX Link is on. It starts at login.
confirm.turnOffLink.title: Turn off RealTimeX Link?
confirm.turnOffLink.message: Published artifacts go offline, webhooks aren't received, the mobile app and other desktops can't reach this computer, and no one can connect for remote control. It won't start at login until you turn it on again.
confirm.useAccount.title: Use {name}?
confirm.useAccount.message: RealTimeX Link signs out of its account and uses RealTimeX's. This computer then has one App ID, and computers that used the old one move over by themselves.
moved.title: This computer now has one App ID
moved.message: RealTimeX Link now shares everything from this computer under RealTimeX's App ID, {appId}. Published links and webhook URLs don't change. Computers that used {old} move over by themselves.
shared.title: Shared from this computer
shared.explain: Set up in RealTimeX. RealTimeX Link keeps them reachable.
shared.closed: What RealTimeX shares comes back when RealTimeX opens.
shared.otherAccount: RealTimeX on this computer is signed in as {realtimex}, so its artifacts, webhooks and mobile access can't go through RealTimeX Link, which uses {link}.
